messages:
nina: heads-up: need to finalize who can request KMS unwraps for SIEM extracts during incidents. also, retention tiers: what's allowed to go to long-term forensics vs short-term?

kevin: quick take: security + compliance sign off on 7y forensics. operationally we should tag streams. proposal: forensics=7y, auth=1y, metrics=90d. prod teams must request forensics tag.

rahul: unwrap flow idea: no user kms:Decrypt. users request via ticket -> sec-oncall approves -> system issues time-limited role to call proxy -> proxy does decrypt and writes audit entry. OPA gate before issuing creds.

oncall: manual approvals are slow in P1s. can we make a fast-path (human approves via slack reaction) that triggers automated STS issuance? must keep audit + ttl.

compliance-bot: reminder: any 7y retention requires documented business justification and retention policy entry. approvals and unwraps must be auditable and immutable.

sec-automation: infra suggestion: instead of unwraps, provide tokenized, scrubbed SIEM exports for common queries. Only allow unwraps for designated forensic owners.

nina: ok action items: kevin -> draft tag->retention table; rahul -> KMS proxy + OPA sketch; sec-automation -> tokenized export design; oncall -> emergency unwrap checklist. i'll open a follow-up with drafts. :thumbsup:
